title: Medium-Throughput Evaluation of Quantum Geometry-Driven Topological Transports in Altermagnets
title_zh: 交变磁体中由量子几何驱动的拓扑输运性质的中通量评估
summary: 该研究建立了中通量第一性原理工作流，对MAGNDATA数据库中的135种交变磁体进行量子几何驱动拓扑输运性质评估。基于自动化Wannier构建，研究计算了反常霍尔效应、磁光克尔效应和体光伏效应等线性与非线性响应，并进行了对称性验证。对VNb3S6、CaIrO3和CuFeS2等代表性材料的分析表明，该方法可用于识别交变磁体中实验可及的指纹特征和功能输运性质。
abstract: Altermagnets provide a promising platform for a wide spectrum of applications integrating advantages of conventional ferromagnets and antiferromagnets. In this work, we implement a medium-throughput first-principles workflow and evaluate topological transport properties driven by quantum geometry for 135 altermagnets in the MAGNDATA database. Based on automated Wannier construction, both linear and nonlinear responses, including the anomalous Hall effect, magneto-optical Kerr effect, and bulk photovoltaic effect, are evaluated with further symmetry verifications. Detailed analysis is done on representative cases like metallic VNb3S6 with enhanced anomalous Hall conductivity, CaIrO3 with giant MOKE, and CuFeS2 with large shift current in non-centrosymmetric. These results establish a symmetry-guided computational route for identifying experimentally accessible fingerprints and functional transport properties in altermagnets.

title: Analysis of Casing Loads in Coalbed Methane Horizontal Wells during Multi-Stage Hydraulic Fracturing
title_zh: 煤层气水平井多段水力压裂过程中的套管载荷分析
summary: 该研究面向鄂尔多斯盆地大牛地气田太原组深部煤层，建立三维地质力学模型和多段压裂复合诱导应力预测模型，以评估压裂过程中套管应力风险。研究结合地应力测试、测井和钻井数据构建岩石力学参数体系，并用裂缝几何与广域电磁监测验证模型可靠性。通过改进单裂缝诱导应力解析模型、参数反演和响应面分析，研究给出了套管应力预测方程及参数敏感性排序，为深部煤层气压裂优化和套管完整性保护提供支持。
abstract: China has abundant deep coalbed methane resources, totaling 40.71 trillion m³, of which more than 30% are distributed in the Ordos Basin. During multi-stage hydraulic fracturing of deep coal seams, fracture propagation induces complex stress redistribution, resulting in abnormal casing stress increases and higher risks of yielding, deformation, and failure. High-flow-rate and large-scale fracturing operations further intensify casing stress responses. To address the strong heterogeneity of deep coal seams and the limited applicability of existing induced-stress models, this study focuses on the Taiyuan Formation coal seam in the Daniudi Gas Field, Ordos Basin. A high-precision three-dimensional geomechanical model was established, and a composite induced-stress prediction model for multi-stage fracturing was developed by integrating theoretical correction and numerical simulation.A static rock mechanical parameter system was first constructed using in-situ stress tests, logging data, and drilling data. Model reliability was verified by fracture geometry and wide-area electromagnetic monitoring results, with the fracture-affected area matching degree exceeding 92%. A modified analytical model for single-fracture induced stress was then developed by introducing fracture net-pressure and stress attenuation distance correction coefficients. Five optimization algorithms were compared for parameter inversion, among which the sparrow search algorithm achieved the best performance, with an R² of 0.9371 and an RMSE of 0.3761. Finally, a multi-stage fracturing composite stress prediction model was established by coupling treatment scale, injection rate, fracture spacing, and stage number. Response surface analysis further yielded a casing stress prediction regression equation and parameter charts, clarifying the sensitivity ranking of fracturing parameters. The results provide theoretical and technical support for fracturing parameter optimization and casing integrity protection in deep coalbed methane reservoirs.

title: Boron layers could set a superconductivity record, theoretical study predicts
title_zh: 理论研究预测：硼层可能创下超导纪录
summary: 中国科学家预测，将两层微观尺度的硼层堆叠起来，可能创造新的超导纪录。传统超导体通常需要接近绝对零度的低温才能工作，因此依赖复杂且昂贵的冷却设备。
abstract: Scientists in China predict that stacking two microscopic layers of boron could set a new record for superconductivity. Superconductors are materials that conduct electricity with zero resistance. Traditional types need temperatures close to absolute zero to work, requiring complex and expensive cooling equipment.

title: Crossing into a mirror world: Particles turn to wisps of fog, and the magnetic monopole paradox dissolves
title_zh: 进入镜像世界：粒子化作雾缕，磁单极子悖论随之消解
summary: 文章借歌德叙事诗《魔王》及舒伯特的配乐意象，引出量子世界中“雾缕”般的新含义。原文暗示，在某种镜像世界或量子情境中，粒子概念发生转化，并与磁单极子悖论的消解相关。
abstract: In Goethe's ballad "Erlkönig," immortalized in Schubert's fevered 1815 setting, a dying boy riding through the night sees a spectral king beckoning from the darkness. His father calms him: "Mein Sohn, es ist ein Nebelstreif"—my son, it is only a wisp of fog. In the poem, the father's reassurance proves tragically wrong. In the quantum world, however, his words acquire an uncanny new meaning.

title: New 'shape-shifting' architecture brings versatility to photonic quantum computing
title_zh: 新的“变形”架构为光子量子计算带来更强的灵活性
summary: 利用光来处理量子信息是构建未来量子计算机最有前景的路径之一。光子是优良的量子信息载体，但它们天然缺乏相互作用，这一直是构建能够执行完整计算任务系统的一大挑战。
abstract: Using light to process quantum information is one of the most promising approaches to building future quantum computers. Light particles, known as photons, are excellent carriers of quantum information, but their lack of natural interactions has created a major challenge for researchers seeking to build systems capable of performing a full range of computations.

title: Tiny floating magnet detects ultrafaint magnetic fields at room temperature
title_zh: 微型悬浮磁体可在室温下探测超微弱磁场
summary: 测量微弱磁场在脑活动成像、心脏监测和基础物理研究等领域具有重要用途。传统上，探测这类弱信号往往需要昂贵或笨重的设备，例如液氦冷却装置或用于屏蔽地磁场的专门屏蔽室。
abstract: Measuring faint magnetic fields is useful in a number of areas, including mapping brain activity, monitoring hearts and probing fundamental physics. Typically, picking up such weak signals requires expensive or bulky equipment, such as liquid-helium cooling tanks or specially shielded rooms that block out Earth's magnetic field.
